items.title: Mose Allison — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: I used to play with him. Then I started taking my own band at Bill Bennett’s

ctx.x: So before you went to LSU and after you return from the Army, when you come back to Tippo in the zoot suit, and you were playing around... What sort of playing were you doing? Just locally around Mississippi?
Well, yeah, I was playing... Bill Bennett had a club in Jackson, Mississippi. He had several clubs. I used to play with him. Then I started taking my own band at Bill Bennett’s, so... I don’t know.
